not_changing: external schemas and contracts outside services/capital/
composes_with: Inbound token authentication and tenant claims

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 1. Capital pools and persona capital bindings and allocation authority and capital audit events carry a tenant id with a migration that backfills existing rows
acceptance_criteria.verification: Added tenant_id column, indexes, and JSONB backfill migration in pg_store.py (migrate_capital_tables) and aggregate backfill in allocation_store.py (backfill_tenant).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 2. Every capital read and write route filters and stamps the caller tenant from the verified token and a caller cannot read or change another tenant's rows
acceptance_criteria.verification: All 23 capital routes filter by caller's verified tenant; responses stamp X-Pantheon-Tenant header and tenant_id; cross-tenant access returns 404 or empty collection.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 3. Rows without a tenant are visible to no caller
acceptance_criteria.verification: Untenanted rows return 404 on direct lookup and are excluded from all list endpoints across pools, bindings, rebalances, allocations, receipts, containments, and audit events.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 4. Tests cover same-tenant and cross-tenant access for every capital route
acceptance_criteria.verification: services/capital/test_tenant_scoping.py covers all 23 capital routes with both same-tenant and cross-tenant assertions (len(TESTED_ROUTES) == 23).
